subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose an after-compaction-only, current-session-scoped `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` contract across core and bundled harnesses?
rationale: This is a new plugin API and session-lifecycle authority surface; implementation review can establish safety defects, but only an owner can approve the permanent public contract and supported lifecycle boundaries.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow contract
options.body: Approve the after-compaction-only API after the cron ownership defects, memory regression guard, compatibility tests, and latest-head runtime proof are complete.

options.title: Keep reset host-internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and retain reset orchestration as an internal owner-controlled recovery path until a broader plugin lifecycle design is approved.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Close or redesign the branch if the cross-caller ownership and upgrade burden is not worth adding this plugin capability.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Approve the after-compaction-only API after the cron ownership defects, memory regression guard, compatibility tests, and latest-head runtime proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is adjacent cron agent/session ownership work, which is where the remaining correctness blocker is concentrated.
